study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: trial of labor after cesarean delivery
age 40 years or more at the time of delivery
cohort: 67,389 women undergoing repeat cesarean delivery or trial of labor after cesarean delivery
finding: Women aged 40 years or older undergoing repeat cesarean delivery or trial of labor after cesarean delivery had a higher risk of maternal complications, including intraoperative transfusion, maternal ICU admission, abnormal placentation, and surgical complications.
mod_finding: This study compared outcomes in women age 40 or older to those younger than 40 undergoing repeat cesarean delivery or trial of labor after cesarean delivery and found no difference in maternal death rates.
